<thought>Based on the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 235.1395, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral mass of ~234.132 Da. The formula that best matches this exact mass is C₁₄H₁₈O₃.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H18O3</final_answer>
